title: Judging the algorithm: A CASE STUDY ON THE RISK ASSESSMENT TOOL FOR GENDER-BASED VIOLENCE IMPLEMENTED IN THE BASQUE COUNTRY
reasoning: The paper provides an interdisciplinary ethical and socio-legal analysis of risk assessment algorithms in the judicial system. It evaluates the impact and harms of algorithmic governance, specifically discussing frameworks like design justice and data feminism within the context of gender-based violence and human-algorithm interaction.
